customSections.label: PSD Opening, Late-Start, and Early-Dismissal Guide
customSections.content: Puyallup uses three different schedule changes during the year: one-hour Monday late starts, 2.5-hour early dismissals, and 3.25-hour early dismissals. Exact start and dismissal times vary by school. PSD's online calendar lists October 5 and June 9 as separate first and last days for Transition to Kindergarten.

customSections.label: How the 2026–27 Emergency Make-Up Sequence Works
customSections.content: PSD has two reserve make-up dates during the school year: February 12 and May 28. If more days are needed after the scheduled June 16 last day, June 17 comes next, followed by additional days beginning June 21. These dates remain no-school days unless PSD activates them.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: The first day for grades 1–12 moves from September 3 in 2025 to September 2 in 2026, while kindergarten remains on September 8.
Fair Day moves from September 10 to September 16, with the same 3.25-hour early dismissal and no lunch.
The two in-year emergency make-up dates shift from February 13 and May 22 in the 2025–26 calendar to February 12 and May 28 in 2026–27.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Puyallup School District start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 start Wednesday, September 2, 2026. Kindergarten starts Tuesday, September 8 after Labor Day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first Puyallup Monday late start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first listed one-hour late start is Monday, September 14, 2026. The pattern continues on designated instructional Mondays through June 14.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Puyallup Fair Day in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fair Day is Wednesday, September 16, 2026. All grades dismiss 3.25 hours early, and lunch is not served.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Transition to Kindergarten start in Puyallup in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: PSD's online calendar lists Monday, October 5, 2026, as the first day of Transition to Kindergarten. That program date is not printed on the one-page PDF.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Puyallup Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs April 5–9, 2027. Students return Monday, April 12 on the one-hour late-start schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Puyallup School District in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Wednesday, June 16, 2027, with a 3.25-hour early dismissal and no lunch. Emergency make-up needs could extend attendance beyond that date.

sourceReviewSummary: Last checked August 8, 2026. We compared PSD's revised 2026–27 student calendar with the district's online calendar and school bell schedules.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF was rendered and checked visually because its color key separates no-school days, one-hour late starts, 2.5-hour early dismissals, 3.25-hour early dismissals, supplemental days, and conditional emergency make-up dates.
The printed monthly student-day counts sum to 180; the staff supplemental days before opening are not presented as student attendance days.
PSD's online calendar confirms the major opening and conference dates and lists October 5 and June 9 as the first and last days of Transition to Kindergarten.
The revised PDF lists February 12 and May 28 as reserve make-up dates. Neither is shown as a regular school day in the version we reviewed.
The footer says lunch is served on attendance days except Fair Day and the last day of school.
PSD's bell page confirms the three schedule lengths but lists different actual times by school, so this page does not assign one clock time to every campus.
sourceNextReviewText: Next review: after PSD revises the July 2026 calendar, changes school bell schedules, or activates a reserve make-up date.
